chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Salama ibn al-Khattab, from Suleiman ibn Sama'ah, from Ali ibn Ismail, from Muhammad ibn Hakim, who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: 'If a man were to die whilst fasting during the journey, I would not pray over him.'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on praying over someone who dies while fasting during travel?
ai.summary: In this hadith from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) links the validity of the funeral prayer to the conformity of the deceased’s practice with the Sunnah, specifically regarding the concession (rukhsah) of not fasting while traveling. This reflects the Shia scholarly view that Salat al-Janazah is not merely a ritual but a testimony to the individual's adherence to Islamic law, implying that dying in a state of 'disliked' or 'optional' fasting during travel may indicate a deviation from the preferred Sunnah.
